proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: $1.80 free credit on signup. FLUX.1-schnell costs $0.0018 per megapixel (~$0.0012/image), yielding ~1,500 free high-quality images.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides lightning-fast, production-grade API endpoints for FLUX.1-schnell, FLUX.1-dev, and SDXL with no cold starts and the absolute lowest pay-as-you-go pricing on the market once credits run out.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Replace Pollinations in the image generation pipeline (e.g., `produce_coloring_book` or `produce_kdp_cover`) with direct curl/requests calls from GitHub Actions.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires setting up a free account to get the token. Credit card not required for the initial free tier, but needed to top up once the $1.80 is exhausted.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: $10.00 free credit upon signing up with a GitHub account. FLUX.1-schnell is priced at $0.001 per image, yielding up to 10,000 free generations.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Incredible developer-first playground and API. Offers optimized pipelines for FLUX (including Schnell, Dev, and LoRA integration) and ultra-fast upscalers (AuraSR, ESRGAN) in a single API call.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Image generation and high-resolution upscaling step in `produce_coloring_book` or `produce_tumbler_wraps` via GitHub Actions workflow.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Strict rate limits on the free tier to prevent abuse, but highly reliable for scheduled cron runs on GitHub Actions.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 2,500 free Google Search / Google Shopping / Google Images queries upon registration. No credit card required.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Bypasses Google CAPTCHAs entirely from headless server environments like GitHub Actions. Returns structured JSON of organic search results, shopping prices, and related questions.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrate into `agent_trendhunter` or `agent_opportunity_hunter` to programmatically scrape high-volume, low-competition search terms and price points for POD.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: API key required. 2,500 queries is a lifetime allotment per free account; requires rotation or transitioning to their low-cost paid tier ($1 per 1,000 queries) for heavy usage.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free to upload, host, and sell 3D models. 0% platform fees on digital sales (payment processing fees apply).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: A rapidly growing 3D printing search engine and marketplace that rivals Cults3D. It utilizes geometric search algorithms, meaning models are discovered based on their physical shape and compatibility, not just keyword SEO.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Publishing pipeline for parametric 3D assets generated in `produce_stl_parametric` to diversify away from Cults3D.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: The audience is highly technical; uploaded models must be 3D-printable without errors (non-manifold geometry will be downranked).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free, open-source, and unlimited. Runs locally on the GitHub Actions runner CPU.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Converts black-and-white raster images (BMP/PNG) into highly scalable, clean SVG vector graphics, then optimizes them by removing redundant metadata to minimize file size.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Post-processing step in `produce_svg_pack` and `produce_coloring_book` to convert AI-generated line art into infinitely scalable vector files for professional POD printing.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Only works effectively on high-contrast, black-and-white line art. Color vectorization requires multi-pass processing which is highly complex to automate via CLI.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: No setup or monthly fees. Flat 10% fee on successful sales. Unlimited file hosting and digital product creation.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides a robust, developer-friendly REST API to programmatically create products, upload digital files (PDF books, ZIP game assets, STL files), and generate direct checkout links.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Automated deployment step in GitHub Actions. Once a coloring book PDF or a gamedev asset pack is compiled, the system can automatically create a new product on Hugo's Gumroad store and return the purchase link.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Gumroad's 10% flat fee is relatively high for high-volume sales, but perfect for a 0-budget bootstrap phase.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100,000 requests per day completely free without an API key (simply include an email address in the request header for the 'polite pool').
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: A massive, fully open index of over 250 million scientific papers, historical documents, and academic concepts. Far more structured and accessible than Wikipedia or Google Scholar APIs.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Used by `agent_ideator_offline` to extract obscure historical facts, public domain concepts, or niche scientific diagrams to generate highly educational KDP books, specialized card games, or trivia packs.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Data is highly academic and raw; requires LLM parsing (via Gemini) to translate into consumer-friendly product ideas.
